items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I work with Manuel a good while. I work with Manuel out to the lake, Mellon Boy.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear Freddie Keppard play when you were a boy?

Yeah, I was Freddie. I was quite a young kid. And around following funerals and advertisements on trucks. And at the time, they had furniture wagons. Used to follow the furniture wagons from corner to corner. And they used to buck one of their main corners for bucking. Mm-hmm. He drew the biggest crowd. My uncle used to play on the front of the wagon quite often. Well, I work with Manuel. I work with Manuel a good while. I work with Manuel out to the lake, Mellon Boy. I was still quite a young man then. I…
I didn't know him. I knew about him. Yeah. Heard him on record.
